Chapter 232: Chapter 20: Star Domain Rankings (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 232: Chapter 20: Star Domain Rankings (Please Subscribe)_2

“It’s time we met.”

Lin Yuan invited his parents and sister into his personal space.

In less than a moment,

Lin Shoucheng, Lu Qiong, and Lin Yi appeared in the personal space.

“Brother…” Lin Yi looked at Lin Yuan with admiration.

Now standing before her was not just her brother, but the Peak Master of Shisan, whose countless fans throughout the Chikun Star Domain yearned for a glimpse.

...

“Xiaoyuan, these few days you spent on the Chikun Main Star, Canglan Star was celebrating like it was a festival. Governor Song personally made an appearance, congratulating you on becoming the Peak Master of Shisan alongside all the citizens. Numerous corporate enterprises even spent vast amounts of money to hang a huge banner outside the planet…”

Lu Qiong said with a smile.

Lin Yuan smiled silently.

Becoming the Peak Master of Shisan had indeed had a profound impact on Canglan Star.

Without mentioning the many other benefits, let me point out one. From now on, Canglan Star might become the ‘must-visit’ holy land of the entire Chikun Star Domain.

Every year, countless tourists from major star domains will specifically visit Canglan Star to witness the planet where the Peak Master of Shisan once resided.

Just from tourism revenue alone, Canglan Star could probably earn a fortune.

Therefore.

All of Canglan Star, from top to bottom, owes Lin Yuan gratitude.

“Xiaoyuan,” Lin Shoucheng was overjoyed, “our Lin Family has truly honored our ancestors… this is not just any honoring of ancestors, I don’t know how many good deeds I did in my past life…”

The ancients say, ‘When one man attains the Dao, his pets ascend to heaven…’

“In our case, it’s more than ascending to heaven, those big shots are nearly kneeling at our doorstep…”

In these past few days, Lin Shoucheng had felt deeply moved. Previously, Lin Yuan was known as the champion of the arena competition.

But in the eyes of Canglan Star’s top decision-makers, he was at most given extra attention, as they valued only Lin Yuan himself.

However, now.

These big shots treated their family even more warmly and respectfully than their own parents.

….

Lin Yuan listened with a smile as his parents and sister shared their feelings.

As the Peak Master of Shisan, his power and influence within the Chikun Star Domain were terrifying. Not just the corporate forces of Canglan Star, but even one of the five great forces of the star domain like the Heiyu Family had to try everything to curry his favor.

And Lin Yuan’s family members were certainly being showered with various praises.

“By the way, Xiaoyuan,”

As if recalling something, Lu Qiong pulled out a list and said, “Governor Song gave me a list to give to you. It contains the names of people who cursed you online during the Heiyu Family incident…”

In this era of interstellar civilization, every citizen enjoys the freedom of speech.

But this ‘freedom of speech’ is on the condition that it does not harm other citizens.

Online insults, strictly speaking, can be pursued by the insulted party.

“Punish the few ringleaders, and let the rest go,”

Lin Yuan looked at the list and said casually.

Given the pressure exerted by the Heiyu Family at that time and their guidance of public opinion, countless citizens had been led astray.

If all were pursued, perhaps one-tenth of Canglan Star’s citizens would be unfortunate.

…

After chatting with his family,

Lin Yuan disconnected the virtual world connection.

“Should be about settled now, right?”

Lin Yuan waited for the response from the Goddess of Wisdom.

A moment later,

The solemn voice of the Goddess of Wisdom transmitted.

“Respected Fifth Rank Citizen Lin Yuan, according to the final verdict, the ‘updated’ Martial Path Evolutionary Path you’ve provided has significantly lowered its threshold and greatly enhanced its potential. Apart from the original value of the evolutionary path, you will be awarded an additional five hundred thousand merit points…”

“Five hundred thousand merit points…” Lin Yuan was somewhat surprised.

This time he had only updated the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, without uploading subsequent content for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

He originally thought that an award of one or two hundred thousand merit points would suffice, so five hundred thousand merit points were unexpected.

To know, even combining the First Tier Chapter to the Fifth Rank Chapter of the previous Martial Path Evolutionary Path wouldn’t even come close to five hundred thousand merit points.

“The probability of advancing to the Sixth Rank is 95%.”

“The probability of advancing to the Seventh Rank is 30%, and the probability of advancing to the Eighth Layer Evolution Path is 10%…”

Lin Yuan also glanced at the latest information on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Hmm, the probability of advancing to the Sixth Rank Evolution Path has not changed, still at 95%.

Lin Yuan slightly nodded, feeling nothing strange.

A 95% chance of advancing to the Sixth Rank represented a very high probability, as most Fifth Rank Evolution Paths have only a 30-40% chance of advancing to the Sixth Rank.

Over 50% is considered extremely good, let alone 95%.

“The chance for advancing to the Seventh Rank has increased by 10%, and the chance for advancing to the Eighth Layer has increased by 5%…”

Lin Yuan speculated that the increase in the probability of advancing to the Seventh and Eighth Ranks was entirely due to the integration of various energy systems, which induced a kind of transformation and sublimation to the entire Martial Arts Evolution System.

“Let’s take a look at the latest rankings of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path.”

Lin Yuan continued to check the updated information of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path, looking at the rankings column.

“First in the Canglan Evolution Ranking…”

“Twelfth in the Chikun Evolution Rankings?”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly; if he remembered correctly, weren’t the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path previously ranked fifty-third in the Chikun Evolution Rankings?

“Twelfth…”

Lin Yuan let out a sigh of relief.

Ordinary Evolvers might not understand what this meant.

But as the Peak Master of Shisan, Lin Yuan naturally knew what it meant to be ranked in the top fifty on the Chikun Evolution Rankings.

The Chikun Evolution Rankings were divided into two levels.

The top fifty.

The bottom fifty.

The Evolution Paths in the top fifty were all Seventh or Eighth Rank Evolution Pathways.

As for the bottom fifty, there were Seventh Rank Evolution Pathways and Sixth Rank Evolution Pathways.

It was already unthinkable for the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path to previously make it to the fifty-third place in the Chikun Evolution Rankings with a Fifth Rank Evolution Pathway.

After all, from fiftieth to one hundredth place in the Chikun Evolution Rankings were either Sixth or Seventh Rank Evolution Pathways.

But now…

The Martial Tao Evolutionary Path had actually made it into the top fifty.

And it was a prominent position in the top fifty, twelfth place.

Keep in mind the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path was still a Fifth Rank Evolution Pathway.

A mere Fifth Rank Evolution Pathway had broken into a ranking dominated by Seventh and Eighth Rank Evolution Pathways?

…

Chikun Prime Virtual World.

Central Plaza Area.

Many Evolvers and high-ranking citizens had gathered.

In pairs and small groups, they talked quietly.

Even though more than a year had passed, the main topic among the many Evolvers on the plaza was still the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path.

There was no choice.

The Martial Tao Evolutionary Path was too exaggerated, too unique.

The top hundred Evolution Paths of the Chikun Evolution Rankings were Sixth, Seventh, and Eighth Rank Evolution Pathways.

The only one mixed in was a Fifth Rank Evolution Pathway; it inevitably drew a second glance.

“I bet that once the Sixth Rank Chapter of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path is uploaded, its ranking will definitely rise again, breaking into the top fifty.”

“Nonsense, now the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path is already in the top fifty-three. Once the Sixth Rank Chapter is uploaded, the overall rank will rise. As long as the Sixth Rank Chapter performs steadily, it could probably break into the top thirty or twenty.”

“All the Evolution Paths in the top fifty of the Chikun Evolution Rankings are Seventh or Eighth Rank Evolution Pathways. If the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path can break into it with a Sixth Rank Evolution Pathway, tsk tsk…..”

…

The many Evolvers talked rapidly among themselves.

Just then…

The Chikun Evolution Rankings began to refresh.

Hum.

The hundred Evolution Paths on the ranking board simultaneously blurred.

All the Evolvers in the plaza stared at the Evolution Rankings full of anticipation.

Several breaths later…

The Chikun Evolution Rankings refresh was complete.

“Damn it.”

“The Martial Tao Evolutionary Path has broken into the top fifty.”

“Not just the top fifty; it’s the twelfth place.”

“Almost broke into the top ten.”

“What’s going on?”

“I thought after uploading the Sixth Rank Chapter, it could about make it into the top twenty or thirty.”

“It seems I still underestimated the scholar who developed this Evolution Path.”

“Let me see what is so exquisite about the Sixth Rank Chapter of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path that it allowed the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path to rise from fifty-third to twelfth place.”

Countless Evolvers, filled with anticipation and excitement, went to the purchasing interface of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path, looking to buy the Sixth Rank Chapter.

Immediately, everyone discovered a horrifying scene.

Martial Tao Evolutionary Path.

Did not have a Sixth Rank Chapter.
